name: Rams Functionalism (UI)
summary: Quiet matt surfaces, a muted grey palette, one orange signal colour and controls that show what they do. It follows Dieter Rams and Braun and appears again in calculators, audio and phone interfaces.

philosophy.core_thesis: Good design is as little design as possible: the product should be useful, understandable and honest, and then step back.
design_principles: Limit the palette to 3 neutrals (warm greys) and one signal colour (orange #E8590C) used on at most 5% of the surface.
Group controls in labelled zones; each control has a text label of 12px to 14px and a fixed place on a 4px grid.
Give each control one job and make its state visible: use a solid fill for on and an outline for off.
Use radius 2px to 4px on buttons and panels; radius never exceeds 8px.
Set all type in one neo-grotesque sans serif at 4 sizes: 12, 14, 18 and 32px.
Arrange panels in a modular layout of equal units of 80px to 120px; align each edge to a unit.
Colour only the thing that signals: a state, a warning or a primary action.
anti_patterns: Decorative gradients, glows and glass effects
Two or more saturated accent colours
Icons without a text label on a primary action
Rounded containers with a radius above 8px
Animation that does not show a state change

layout.grid_mechanics: A modular grid of 8 columns with 16px gutters and a 4px baseline; controls sit in equal units of 80px to 120px and group by function.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 35% to 50% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush left; labels sit above or left of controls; groups align to a shared baseline.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with a 2px to 4px radius; thin 1px dividers; groups sit on a surface one step lighter or darker than the ground.

font_pairings.note: A single-family setting, in the neutral voice of Akzidenz-Grotesk.
A close match to Helvetica for labels and text.
A grotesque with a mono face for values and units.

typography.tracking: Display takes -0.01em; body stays at 0; labels take +0.04em.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and medium (500) or bold (700) for labels.
Set labels in lower case or sentence case at 12px.
Show a value in a mono face with tabular numerals.

color.palette_structure: Warm greys with one orange signal.
color.contrast_rules: Graphite on fog holds at least 11:1; orange marks state and primary action only.
color.surface_treatment: Matt, flat or very slightly tonal fields; a step of 4% to 8% lightness separates a group from the ground.
color.light_and_shadow: Almost none; a 1px inner edge in white at 60% opacity simulates a pressed edge on controls.

materiality.surface_simulation: Matt moulded plastic and anodised aluminium, drawn in flat tone with no texture.
materiality.border_rules: 1px dividers in a darker grey (#C4C1BA); controls have a 1px border in the same grey.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur. Elevation is shown by one tone step and a 1px edge, not by shadow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Plain pictograms with a 1.5px stroke, butt caps and mitre joins, always with a text label for a primary action.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Product photographs on a grey ground or plain diagrams of the control layout; no decorative illustration.

motion.transition_physics: Translation for screen: short, mechanical moves that mimic a switch; state changes in one step with no overshoot.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises the tone of a control by 4%; active state fills it with the signal colour.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels that the object is honest, quiet and easy to use.

avoid_when: The brand must feel emotional, loud or playful.
The page is an editorial feature with big images.
The audience expects rich visual effects.

modifiers.how: Add wood and earth tones and a second warm hue; keep the 4px grid and labels.
Remove the control groups and the surfaces; keep type and the single accent.
Add elevation levels of 1dp to 8dp and a 12px radius; keep the signal colour.

pack.why: A thin, even line with a plain pictogram form, always shown with a label.
